parties.evidence: by and among Aizu Fujitsu Semiconductor Limited, Fujitsu Semiconductor Limited, and Transphorm, Inc.

agreement_date.evidence: THIS JOINT VENTURE AGREEMENT (“Agreement”) is made as of this 23rd day of May, 2017

effective_date.evidence: “Effective Date” means the date that the Initial Closing occurs.

governing_law.evidence: this Agreement and the legal relations among the Parties and the Company shall in all respects be interpreted, construed and governed by and in accordance with the laws of Japan.

change_of_control.evidence: By FSL/AFSL and TPH/TPH-A, if there is a change in the Control of the other and the acquiring/succeeding entity causing such change in the Control is an entity that may be reasonably believed to be objectionable to the Japanese Government and/or FSL including FSL’s Affiliates in case of the termination by FSL/AFSL or the US Government and/or TPH in case of the termination by TPH/TPH-A, termination to be effective upon thirty (30) days’ notice of termination.
